# Qualification Contract

`local-ci` implements only the `LOCAL` strategy of the shared Qualification stage. Read `_protocol/delivery/READY_FOR_CI.md`, `READY_FOR_MERGE.md`, and `REQUALIFICATION.md` as canonical contracts.

A successful result proves all profile-defined local commands passed for the exact current candidate and profile fingerprint. It does not prove GitHub-native checks passed and does not authorize Integration when later identity/profile drift invalidates the evidence.
